{{Top|leg}}
An '''inert power insulator''' was one of the many components of a [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilt]]. It provided a means of insulating the [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] from the handle itself, thus preventing any leakage from electrocuting the weapon's owner, due to its composition of matter that did not conduct electrical current.
